messages:
anna (product): Quick sync — need a short walkthrough for the operator-handshake we discussed for cascading fallback playbooks. Can we sketch the user steps and the audit footprint?

mike (eng-platform): Sure. thinking in terms of: 1) preview/simulate 2) enable in dry-run 3) gradual ramp + operator ack 4) full enable. Audit should capture decision_id, input signature, trigger reason, chosen degrade mode.

lee (sre): +1. Also we need the error->degrade mapping and sample rates logged so post-mortem can replay. What fields do we want on the event?

mike (eng-platform): Minimal event schema: {decision_id, timestamp, route, model_variant, trigger, sample_rate, operator_action}. We can stick it in tracing + append to an append-only audit log.

sam (ops): UX note: operators want a single click to acknowledge a handoff and a tiny modal that shows "why" (latency spike, 5xx rate) + link to recent traces. Can the preview show sample output differences?

mike (eng-platform): Yes. Console will show a side-by-side sample: current model vs fallback variant, plus statistics for the last 10k requests. Dry-run toggles sampling so you can see approx impact without switching traffic.

anna (product): For the docs let's call the modes: soft-degrade (sample), full-degrade (100%), and graceful-fallback (fallback + reduced features). Operators should be able to patch a timeline and TTL.

lee (sre): We need explicit triggers: latency_p95 > X, error_rate_5m > Y, OOM_count, region_blackout. Each trigger should include hysteresis windows and a TTL for the degrade.

mike (eng-platform): Example policy snippet (for the console + API):

```yaml
name: cascading-fallback-playbook-sample
triggers:
  - id: latency_spike_p95
    metric: latency_p95
    threshold_ms: 1200
    window: 5m
    hysteresis: 2m
    sample_rate: 0.1 # dry-run sampling when preview on
degrade_sequence:
  - mode: soft-degrade
    action: route_to_variant
    variant: small-quantized
    escalate_after: 10m
  - mode: graceful-fallback
    action: reduce_features
    features: [streaming, long_context]
    escalate_after: 30m
  - mode: full-degrade
    action: route_to_safe_model
    variant: safe-512
audit:
  enabled: true
  retention_days: 90
  include_fields: [decision_id, trigger, sample_rate, operator_action]
```

sam (ops): That looks good. question: when an operator clicks "ack & escalate" how does the system show stale decisions vs new ones? We need idempotency.

mike (eng-platform): We'll emit a decision_id UUID with each activation and expose a status timeline. Clicking ack attaches your operator id to the decision and creates an "override" decision (new UUID) that references the prior one. All decisions are immutable.

lee (sre): Telemetry hooks: please include decision_id as a header in downstream logs: X-Decision-Id. That makes trace joins trivial. Also please create a sparse counter metric: fallback_decisions_total{mode,reason,operator}.

mike (eng-platform): Agree on the header. Small API change: activation endpoint returns {decision_id, preview_link, dry_run_sample_rate}. We'll add header support on the runtime side.

anna (product): UX edgecases: 1) show which customer routes are affected, 2) estimate cost impact when switching to fallback (up/down) 3) let users schedule hours (e.g., don't switch during peak).

sam (ops): For audit we should also capture the exact policy version (hash), and a snapshot of the sanitized prompt set used in preview. Privacy: trim PII.

mike (eng-platform): Implementation notes: policy version hash + config blob stored in object store. Preview snapshots are ephemeral and linked from the audit event. We'll sanitize via existing PII scrubber.

lee (sre): One more: automatic rollback triggers. If error rate doesn't drop within escalate_after window, auto-rollback? Or escalate to human? I prefer escalate to human + throttle rampback.

mike (eng-platform): Let's default to: escalate to human on non-improvement, but allow an ops policy to auto-rollback after N failures. That's a field in the policy: auto_rollback: {enabled: bool, after: 3}.

anna (product): Could we add a tiny "simulate timeline" button that spins the timeline with fake metric spikes so PM/CS can preview impact? Not necessary for MVP but high value.

sam (ops): MVP scope: preview + dry-run + operator ack + decision_id + header + audit log. Good to iterate on simulate later.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: mike/eng-platform triggered deploy of feature/handshake-api v1.2 -> staging at 2026-03-23T15:10:22Z

mike (eng-platform): Nice. final action items: I will make the API PR for X-Decision-Id header + activation payload. sam will mock the console preview UI. lee will add metrics/alert hooks. anna will draft the product microcopy and runbook.

anna (product): Thanks — can we have a short async doc with the event schema for auditing and the sample UI mock by EOD Thursday? :thumbsup:

mike (eng-platform): Yep — will drop a short spec + example events in #docs.

lee (sre): I'll add the fallback_decisions_total metric to the infra prometheus job and a Grafana panel.

sam (ops): I'll prototype the modal and the side-by-side sample generator.

anna (product): Great work team. We'll reconvene after staging smoke tests.
